lev >= 30 sets OF_PROT_FEAR. Exact level 30 retained.
TV_HAFTED or OF_BLESSED gives melee damage bonus; Japanese states blessed or hafted weapon without inventing hit bonus.

Damage/melee grants SP; percent /= -2 yields ordinary half-rate decay; natural decay converts HP at twice casting efficiency; conversion scales missing HP. Source-level general description retained, without inventing exclusions/amounts.
